caption: Three ways a signal can travel from one transmitter: the direct wave (line of sight), the ground wave hugging the surface, and the sky wave bent back to Earth by the ionosphere.
spoken: This figure shows one transmitter sending a signal three ways: a direct line-of-sight wave to a nearby car, a ground wave that hugs the surface and quickly fades, and a sky wave that the ionosphere bends back down to a distant station.
